headlines.title: China seen doing ‘just enough’ with targeted fiscal support to defend GDP growth
headlines.summary:
China’s finance minister has pledged to roll out incremental and targeted fiscal policies to help achieve leadership’s full-year growth target for the country, following a freshly announced package of supportive measures. However, analysts expect Beijing to stop short of a major stimulus, providing only “just enough” support to meet the target.
Lan Foan made the pledge in an article published on Thursday in the Communist Party’s leading theoretical journal, Qiushi, calling for the broadened...
headlines.title_zh: 中国被视为以定向财政支持做到‘恰到好处’以捍卫GDP增长
headlines.summary_zh:
中国财政部长承诺推出增量、有针对性的财政政策，以帮助实现领导层设定的全年增长目标，此前刚宣布了一系列支持性措施。然而，分析师预计北京不会推出大规模刺激，只会提供“恰好足够”的支持来实现目标。

headlines.title_en: Ireland cuts energy tax in budget to appease voters
headlines.summary_en: Ireland will cut fuel-related taxes as part of a series of energy measures to help voters and calm public anger that escalated into protests earlier this year. The government will reduce the carbon tax on home heating oil and natural gas, and extend the temporary excise cut on motor fuels through the end of February 2027. The Finance Ministry unveiled a package of personal income tax measures and also announced an increase in the minimum wage, a higher threshold for the Help to Buy scheme, and an expanded rent tax credit, among other measures.

headlines.title: 机构警告：贝森特若取消20年期美国国债，可能推高收益率
headlines.summary: 法国巴黎银行表示，财政部长斯科特·贝森特应抵制取消20年期国债的呼声，因为此举可能导致借贷成本上升。 债券交易员正在猜测贝森特是否可能进一步将国家借款从长期债券转向短期债务——目前长期债券的收益率接近数十年高位。削减或取消20年期国债的发行已成为一种激进选项，因为该期限债券要求的收益率高于相邻期限。

headlines.title_en: Institutions warn: Bessent's cancellation of 20-year US Treasuries could push up yields
headlines.summary_en: BNP Paribas said Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent should resist calls to cancel the 20-year Treasury bond because doing so could raise borrowing costs. Bond traders are speculating whether Bessent may further shift the country's borrowing from long-term bonds to short-term debt, as long-term bond yields are near multi-decade highs. Reducing or eliminating issuance of the 20-year Treasury has become a radical option because that maturity requires a higher yield than neighboring maturities.

headlines.title: 爱尔兰为新储蓄计划设定5万欧元免税门槛
headlines.summary: 爱尔兰新设的零售储蓄与投资账户将享有5万欧元的免税额度，超过该额度的账户余额按1%的统一税率征税。爱尔兰投资账户每年最高缴款上限为1.2万欧元，无最低缴款要求，并允许投资股票、债券、ETF及其他基金。该账户不征收资本利得税，也不适用“视同处置”规则；财政部长西蒙·哈里斯表示，这是投资计划的第一阶段，他愿意重新审视缴款上限。

headlines.title_en: Ireland sets €50,000 tax-free threshold for new savings plan
headlines.summary_en: Ireland's newly created retail savings and investment account will enjoy a tax-free allowance of 50,000 euros, with balances above that threshold taxed at a flat rate of 1%. The Irish investment account will have an annual maximum contribution cap of 12,000 euros, with no minimum contribution requirement, and will allow investment in stocks, bonds, ETFs and other funds. The account will not be subject to capital gains tax, nor will deemed disposal rules apply; Finance Minister Simon Harris said this is the first phase of the investment plan and that he is willing to revisit the contribution cap.

headlines.title_en: Thailand plans to cut biofuel tax to reduce crude oil imports
headlines.summary_en: Thailand's government is considering cutting the excise tax on biofuels to lower prices and spur consumption. Energy Ministry spokesman Pongpol Yodmuangcharoen said at a Wednesday news conference that the Energy Ministry and Finance Ministry are drafting the tax-cut plan. Pongpol said biofuels are made by blending gasoline or diesel with biomass fuels and can be produced locally at low cost. The excise tax on biogasoline and biodiesel is about 6 baht per liter. Expanding biofuel use will help reduce crude oil imports and ease pressure on the government's fuel subsidies.

headlines.summary: 【假期要闻汇总】国庆节假期影响市场的重要资讯有：央行10月8日将开展12000亿元买断式逆回购操作，期限为3个月；财政部部长蓝佛安称要研究制定针对性强的增量政策，更加注重扩大国内有效需求；普京说中美俄领导人可能在APEC峰会期间举行三方会晤，外交部回应；商务部就法德要求欧盟强化贸易防御等保护主义工具答记者问；特朗普宣布成立“超级智能特别工作组”；美国非农意外“爆冷”，美联储10月加息概率骤降；华为官宣和美国高通达成重磅协议；本年度诺贝尔奖陆续揭晓，多家公司布局相关赛道。

headlines.title_en: Holiday news roundup: Nonfarm payrolls unexpectedly "cool" and the probability of a Fed rate hike in October drops sharply
headlines.summary_en: [Holiday News Roundup] Important market-moving news during the National Day holiday included: the PBOC will conduct 1.2 trillion yuan of outright reverse repurchase operations on October 8 with a term of 3 months; Finance Minister Lan Fo'an said targeted incremental policies should be studied and formulated, with greater emphasis on expanding effective domestic demand; Putin said the leaders of China, the US and Russia may hold trilateral talks during the APEC summit, and the Foreign Ministry responded; the Commerce Ministry answered questions on France and Germany urging the EU to strengthen protectionist tools such as trade defenses; Trump announced the creation of a "Super Intelligence Task Force"; US nonfarm payrolls unexpectedly came in weak, sharply lowering the probability of a Fed rate hike in October; Huawei officially announced a major agreement with US-based Qualcomm; this year's Nobel Prizes were announced one after another, with many companies positioning in related sectors.
